svg.title: Three approval lanes in Cloudflare OS at commit 5cae880e
svg.desc: A call from the agent reaches a Gatekeeper and takes one of three lanes: a native simulated write that lets the agent continue, an awaitDecision write that pauses the agent turn while a manual decision is pending, or an MCP tool labelled readOnlyHint true that runs immediately with no approval.
svg.text: Where a Cloudflare OS agent call goes (commit 5cae880e)
Read from source; lanes are per Gatekeeper write path, not a platform-wide default
1. Simulated write: the agent keeps working
Native Gatekeepers with hand-built overlays (GitHub, Google, Notion, Home Assistant, ...).
Reads replay the pending journal; the user approves or rejects later.
2. awaitDecision write: the agent turn pauses
MCP tool calls not labelled read-only, Supabase mutating SQL, ZoomInfo paid enrichment.
Suspends while a manual decision is pending; resumes when all are approved; a denial ends it.
3. Read on the server's word: no approval at all
An MCP tool whose annotation says readOnlyHint: true runs immediately and is logged
as an observation, on both trust tiers. A mislabelled destructive tool lands here too.
Other tools queue; write auto-approval needs a vetted portal, two hints, a user rule.
Sources: gatekeeper-kit/src/actions.ts, mcp-shared/src/session.ts and tools.ts, workshop-backend/src/overseer.ts
